title: Deep knowledge of history
text: Ivan is a great acquaintance with the history of Spain and knows how to convey his knowledge. He showed us incredible details of Zahara and Ronda. He is an extremely kind person, easy to live with and a skilled and conscientious driver.

title: This was our favorite excursion of...
text: This was our favorite excursion of our trip. Truly unique place. The views, the bull ring, the food was all fantastic. Had a very knowledgeable guide who has spent her whole life in Ronda so really knew it inside and out. Our driver, Jan, was the best. easy going, willing to adjust to our needs, made us feel safe. Highly recommend.
author: Donald O
